0022600147.text: The Utah Jazz (1-4, 5th in the Northwest and 12th in the West) host the Portland Trail Blazers (3-1, 2nd in the Northwest and 4th in the West) in the Jazz's sixth game of the 2026-27 season, with Utah on a three-game losing streak and Portland coming off a loss. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and Utah lost all four meetings with Portland in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 124-114 defeat in Portland.
